evidence.kind: Literal source grey body beside original atlas; not textured native animation.

binding: RenderAlligatorSnappingTurtle returns alligator_snapping_turtle.png and nested MossLayer rerenders same parent model with alligator_snapping_turtle_moss.png.
moss_alpha: min(1,.15*clamp(Moss,0,10)); absent whenMoss<=0. No moss mesh or separate creature.
scale: Renderer TurtleScale<.01 falls back1, otherwise exactscale; young modelscale.25 andheadscale1.5. Entity getScale separately returns.3young/1adult. These paths are distinct, not one assumed collision/render scale.
observation: Main atlas uses broad dark shell panels and muted lighter neck/underside, sparse organized scute divisions. Moss overlay marks selective shell/limb regions ontransparent background; does not replace body anatomy.
